messages:
maria.cs: Urgent heads-up — FinWave is seeing repeated request timeouts from their dedicated pool (eu-west-1-prod). Customer SLA 99.95%. Error rate ~5% for last 10m. Ticket FW-212 has traces but we need an engineering owner for triage right now.

ops-bot: Alert posted: high tail latency on cluster eu-west-1-prod. Incident INC-2026 created (auto).

sam.platform: I can kick off triage. @leo.runtime can you check KV cache/backpressure and GPU queue lengths? Any recent rollout to that pool?

leo.runtime: Looking. No config rollouts in last 24h. Early look at RT logs shows lots of small requests piling up and several failed model loads: 
```
ERROR inference: model_load_timeout model=redwood-r1 v=2025-11-02 pool=eu-west-1-prod
WARN runtime: kv_cache_evictions=4300 backlog=720 avg_latency_p50=45ms p95=890ms p99=1.8s
```

anya.sre: Possible options: 1) scale up pool (add 2 nodes) — ~12min to spin; 2) rollback to previous model binary (if load errors are model-related) — ~25min including canary; 3) failover customer to hosted for short window (need CS approval). Which do we want first?

sam.platform: Priority order: triage now -> if model_load_timeouts confirmed, rollback canary (owner: leo) -> if rollback fails or is blocked, scale up as mitigation (owner: caleb.oncall) -> if still degraded, enable hosted failover for FinWave (owner: maria.cs + support).

maria.cs: I'll tell FinWave we're investigating and ask for any request samples. I can enable hosted failover if engineering asks me to; will need 15–20m to update their routing and confirm billing tolerances.

leo.runtime: Found root cause hypothesis: recent quantization patch (rev ab9c) increases cold-start memory pressure for certain models; memory spikes cause some model loads to fail and backpressure to rise. Reproduced locally with load test. Plan: revert quant patch for pool and redeploy older binary as canary. ETA for canary rollback and verification: 35–40 minutes.

caleb.oncall: I'll prepare autoscaling runbook and add two nodes to pool as a fallback; 10–15m for node spin + 5m to rebalance. If leo's rollback looks risky, I'll execute scaling.

jess.eng: I'll open the PR for a hotfix that disables the offending quant path and add tests to prevent regression. PR draft: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-4821 (owner: jess.eng). Target merge + canary deploy within 3h.

sam.platform: Summarizing commitments and milestones: 
- 00:00 (now) triage owned by sam.platform + leo.runtime + anya.sre
- +15m: confirm hypothesis and either start rollback or start scale-up (owner decision)
- +40m: canary rollback deployed (if chosen) and verification (leo)
- +3h: hotfix PR merged and staged rollout (jess)
- Fallback: hosted routing available as temporary mitigation once CS approves (maria)

maria.cs: Noted. I'll notify FinWave that we expect a canary rollback within ~40m, and will offer hosted failover if SLA continues to degrade.

sam.platform: I'll own the post-mortem and SLA impact calc. Please add any logs/links in INC-2026. React with :thumbsup: when you accept assigned action.

leo.runtime: Accepted. :thumbsup:

caleb.oncall: Accepted. :thumbsup:

jess.eng: On it — PR linked. :eyes:

anya.sre: I'll keep watch on alerts and paging. If we need emergency rollback, ping me directly.

maria.cs: Thanks team. I'll update customer and keep this thread for async updates.

(Incident thread continued in INC-2026; will paste final timeline here after resolution.)
